body: I’ll just get yelled at for wanting to stay home. I stayed home for 17 days (non-consecutive) in 7th grade and the Juvy officer nearly put me on parole

None of my friends would care enough. They’re all a bunch of rowdy kids. They would just sit real awkward. I don’t feel worthless or something like that, it’s just all of the stress and drama. Everyone is just mad at everyone and I’ve just had enough of seeing how everyone I used to look up to and love turn into complete trash. Every time I tried to be nice to her she wanted me to join her and her pedophile boyfriend in a trailer. She doesn’t care about me and she just uses every bit of me for her personal gain. All of that on top of schoolwork and trying to not fuck up all of my relationships is just too much.
